Subject: Slow load on the Velmora store · measured 2 October

Hi Ines,

I am Tom Farran and I build WordPress sites for local shops. On 2 October I measured the Velmora store with PageSpeed from a phone, and the home page took 6.1 seconds to show the first product.
Most of the weight is three cover photos of 2 MB each and a chat plugin that loads even when nobody opens it. With the photos compressed and the chat loaded on click, similar stores I worked on went to under half that time, though yours would need its own measurement.
I did not touch anything on the site; I only looked at what any visitor sees. If it helps, I can send the two-page note with what I found and what I would do first.
If this is not yours to decide, tell me who handles it and I will not write again.

Best,
Tom Farran

items.text:
Hi Carla,

Thanks for the sales sheets from April to September. I checked them against the till system and found two things worth sorting out before Tuesday.
First, June has 312 receipts that are in the till and not in the sheet, nearly all from the Quillen Street shop. It looks like one day that was never exported, the 14th, but Hernan, who does the closing, has to confirm it.
Second, the pensioner discount is sometimes entered as a percentage and sometimes as a fixed amount. That is why the July margin shows 3 points lower than it is.
I put both cases in a separate sheet, marked in yellow, so the original stays as it was. If we settle that on Tuesday, the dashboard can go out with the whole half year.

Cheers,
Nick
